chapter: On the road, Philadelphia and New York
title: Playing prisons and the Gossman's Dock review
summary: He plans a Raybrook show and says prison audiences are very appreciative.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: the sign up there-- and carry a nice review up there every summer. Been goin' up there for quite a while. Maxine Sullivan's been up there, and Bucky Pizzarelli -- guest star, you know. So I'm gonna take a thing up to Lake Placid, or either Raybrook which is near Lake Placid, for the inmates, 'cause I got a call from there and they voted for me to come up. So I'm tryin' to take Ruth Brown and Big Nick Nicholas and my little trio, and probably a shake dancer. I'm gonna do that. It's already in the making. They'll call me next Friday and we'll set it up.
Did you ever play a prison before?
Not here -- yeah I've played prisons, sure played Baltimore and somewhere else.

Oh, Now you're talkin' entertainment, these guys -- well that's what they need, They need something and they really appreciate it. It's no problem. Everything is nice, you know. You can even get to hang out to a certain extent. I know quite a few fellas up there, you know. So, I'll be glad to do it. I got the personnel, it's just a matter of what the date is going be. I don't even know what the name of the prison -- I think it's Raybrook.
